AI settings description: If you want to use AI code generation, you can define API keys for the corresponding providers here. Only the key for the provider you use is required.
Activate syntax help for these npm modul: Activate syntax help for these npm modules
Allow scripts to read the credentials: Allow scripts to read the credentials
Allow self-signed certificates for URL r: Allow self-signed certificates for URL requests
Create states for all astro times: Create states for all astro times
Custom API Base URL: Custom API Base URL (e.g. for Ollama, LM Studio)
Custom API Base URL help: Leave empty for OpenAI. For Ollama use http://localhost:11434/v1
Custom API key help: Only needed if your provider requires authentication
Do not subscribe all states on start: Do not subscribe all states on start

Maximum setState requests per Minute per: Maximum setState requests per Minute per Script
Strict options description: Every option below follows "strict" as long as it is not explicitly enabled or disabled.
The credentials of the central storage a: The credentials of the central storage are available in the scripts, e.g. SECRETS.CameraPassword.key
This path is not allowed for mirroring. Please change it.
TypeScript settings description: These options are used to compile the TypeScript scripts. Changes take effect after the instance has been restarted.
Used as end of the daytime: Used as end of the daytime
Used as start of the daytime: Used as start of the daytime
noEmitOnError help: Do not start scripts that contain compilation errors.
skipLibCheck help: Skip the type check of all declaration files. Speeds up the compilation.
strict help: Enables all strict type checks. TypeScript 6 enables this by default, the adapter switches it off, so existing scripts keep working.
target help: ECMAScript version the scripts are compiled for. Also determines the syntax help in the editor.
tooltip_enableExec: Allow calling of exec in scripts
tooltip_enableSendToHost: Allow to send messages to hosts in scripts
tooltip_enableSetObject: Allow changes of the system objects in scripts
tooltip_latitude: Latitude as 5.345 to use astro functions
tooltip_libraries: Additional NPM libraries divided by comma. You can access them with require('name') in scripts.
tooltip_longitude: Longitude as 5.345 to use astro functions
useDefineForClassFields help: Emit class fields with the native define semantics. May change the behavior of existing scripts.
useUnknownInCatchVariables help: Type the error variable in "catch" blocks as "unknown" instead of "any".
mirrorPath forbidden: This path is not allowed for mirroring. Please change it.
mirrorPath help: A dedicated, empty directory outside the ioBroker installation, writable by the iobroker user. If a folder disappears there, the scripts in it are deleted from the database.
